title: Dealer records and cancelling an allocation
rule: Registered dealers must keep records and must not trade with an unlicensed producer. The Committee may cancel an allocation.
points: Keep records of sources, allocation certificates, licences and transit passes.
An authorised officer may enter premises at any time to inspect storage, wholesale or retail trade.
Cancellation needs evidence of failure to meet conditions, or public interest, and the holder gets a hearing.
Appeal against cancellation: to the Minister within 30 days, then administrative review in the High Court.
penalty: Fine of TSh 1,000,000 to 2,000,000, or three times the value of the produce if greater, or 1 to 2 years in prison, or both.
